data.name: Raizel
data.gender_notes: Raizel is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raizel is derived from the Arabic word 'Raiz' which means rain. It is also associated with the gemstone 'Ruby', symbolizing joy and happiness. The name Raizel carries the meaning “Rain, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Raizel usually hope their child will grow to embody rain, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Raizel holds deep spiritual significance in Islam as it reminds us of Allah's blessings in the form of rain, which nurtures and sustains life on Earth.
data.etymology: Raizel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rain, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raizel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رايزل

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رايزل مشتق من الجذر العربي ر-ي-ز، ويعني الجذر أو الأصل أو البداية. ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه يعني الارتفاع أو الازدياد. يستخدم الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك أصول قوية وبداية مشرفة.

in_urdu.name: رایزل
in_urdu.meaning: نام مطلب ہے جڑ یا اصل یا شروعات
in_urdu.long_meaning: رایزل نام عربی جڑ ر-ی-ز سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے جڑ یا اصل یا شروعات۔ بعض تفاسیر میں اس کا مطلب ارتفاع یا ازدیاد بھی بیان کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام بعض اسلامی ثقافتوں میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو مضبوط جڑوں اور شریف آغاز کا حامل ہو.

in_hindi.name: रायज़ल
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है जड़ या मूल या शुरुआत
in_hindi.long_meaning: रायज़ल नाम अरबी जड़ र-य-ज़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जड़ या मूल या शुरुआत। कुछ व्याख्याओं में इसका अर्थ ऊंचाई या वृद्धि भी बताया गया है। यह नाम कुछ इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जिसके पास मजबूत जड़ें और सम्मानजनक शुरुआत होती है।

in_english.meaning: Name means root, origin, or beginning in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raizel is derived from the Arabic root ر-ي-ز (r-y-z), which means root, origin, or beginning. Some interpretations also relate it to elevation or increase. In Islamic cultures, the name is used to signify a person with strong roots and a noble beginning. Etymologically, it connects to concepts of foundational strength and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: Raizel is an uncommon name in the Islamic community, but its origins in the Arabic language and the connection to rain make it a beautiful and meaningful name. In various Islamic cultures, rain is often seen as a gift from Allah SWT, bringing life-giving water to arid lands and symbolizing blessings and refreshing renewal. In naming a child Raizel, parents may hope for blessings of sustenance, abundance, and joy in their child's life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Raizel can carry deeper spiritual meaning. The name is derived from 'Raiz,' which can also mean the root or foundation. This interpretation may remind parents and the child of their connection to their faith and their commitment to build a strong foundation of faith in their lives. Additionally, the association with the Ruby gemstone can symbolize the child's radiant joy and light, reminding us of the Hadith: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us all radiant and glowing. He arrived at noon or about noon, Yawm al-Nisa' (Thursday)... When he reached us, he placed his feet in the mosque, saying, 'O Allah, I believe in You and in Your Messenger and in Islam as my religion!" (Bukhari, Vol 1, Book 2, Hadith 13). The name Raizel, symbolizing the joy and renewal of rain, can serve as a reminder of the beauty and joy of faith and the importance of building a strong foundation in one's spiritual life.
